libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Port the generated tests to the jetty-io 10.0.0 API. Do not reuse the 9.4.47 test sources unchanged. Specifically: ChannelEndPoint no longer exists in org.eclipse.jetty.io, so use SocketChannelEndPoint or the 10.x base type directly. Connection implementations must implement onClose(Throwable), and the old onClose() override no longer applies. IncludeExcludeConnectionStatistics has no getConnectionStatisticsGroups(), so check the 10.0.0 sources for the replacement accessor. Jetty 10 requires Java 11 or later, which the JDK 25 build already satisfies.
